alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 1 at 12:29AM PDT until October 8 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures ranging
from the mid 80s to around 90 near the coast to the lower to mid
90s near higher coastal terrain expected. Nights will be very warm
with low temperatures mostly in the lower to mid 70s.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Friday to 8 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.
